name: io.github.YaakovTzedek/tzedek-ai-mcp
title: Learn AI with Yaakov Tzedek
description: Search and read practical AI guides, AI courses, learning paths and AI news from tzedek.me.

tools.name: about_ai_tv
tools.description: What AI TV is (Yaakov Tzedek's AI learning app): platforms, what a subscription includes, current plans and prices as shown on the site, lesson language, and the download and site links.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: One course from tzedek.me: description, the syllabus (lesson titles in order), lesson count, total minutes when known, which lessons are free to preview, the price as shown on the site and the course url. Lesson videos and paid lesson content are never returned; the learner watches them on tzedek.me or in the AI TV app.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The full text of one tzedek.me guide or article as clean markdown, with its canonical url, date and FAQ. Pass a slug from search_guides, latest_ai_news or get_learning_path. Cite the returned url when you teach from it.

tools.name: get_learning_path
tools.description: An ordered learning path for a goal such as "build AI agents", "AI for marketing", "Claude Code", "automate my business" or "make AI videos": a quick interactive course first, then the most relevant free guides, then the in depth video course, all real items from the tzedek.me catalogue with their urls.

goal.description: What the learner wants to be able to do.

tools.name: latest_ai_news
tools.description: The latest AI news articles from tzedek.me, newest first, with title, summary, date and url. lang "he" is the daily Hebrew news desk; "en" the English news articles.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: The AI course catalogue on tzedek.me: video courses and short interactive courses, with a one line promise, lesson language, price as shown on the site and the course url. Filter with `topic`: one of agents, claude, chatgpt, build, video, google, work, models, or any free text (e.g. "n8n"). Use get_course for the syllabus.

topic.description: Topic id (agents, claude, chatgpt, build, video, google, work, models) or free text.

kind.description: Only video courses or only interactive courses.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Yaakov Tzedek's practical AI guides and articles on tzedek.me (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, AI agents, MCP, automation, AI video and images, AI for business). Returns title, summary, date and the canonical url of each match. Use get_guide with a returned slug to read the full guide. lang "en" searches the English guides, "he" the larger Hebrew library.

query.description: What to learn about, e.g. "Claude Code skills" or "build an AI agent".
